$comment: Shield face layout by the length of vehicle.state.shields.faces (VARIABLE per ship; NOT the generator count). Verified 2026-11-21: MISC_Prospector len 1 (bubble, 3 generators), RSI_Perseus len 4 (quadrants, 2 generators). Face ORDER is unverified: labels stay F1..Fn until confirmed. ring = face indexes drawn as ring segments clockwise from the top (front); pips = face indexes drawn as top/bottom markers inside the ring. Any other count renders as N equal ring segments labelled F1..Fn. overrides_by_class: {CLASS: {layout, labels, ...}} wins over by_count for that telemetry class_name. Served by the bridge at GET /api/shield-faces; the OpenDeck plugin bundles a fallback copy.

4.note: 4 faces verified on RSI_Perseus; which index is front/left/right/back is not
4.order_note: Index 2 (F3) = LEFT, verified 2026-11-21 on ANVL_Paladin (PTU 5.0) by tuning Front 60 / Left 220 / Right 60 / Back 60 → faces [0.6,0.6,1.0,0.6]. F1/F2/F4 are front/right/back in unknown order.

6.note: 6-face ships not yet observed; top/bottom indexes are a guess

tuning.meaning: At full charge each face value = that face's tuning share / 100% (balanced = 1.0), clamped to 1.0. Shares always total 4.0 (400%) on 4-face ships.
tuning.evidence: ANVL_Paladin PTU 5.0: 80/160/80/80 → [0.8,0.8,1.0,0.8]; 60/220/60/60 → [0.6,0.6,1.0,0.6]; overall level regenerated to 1.0 while tuned-down faces held at their share.
tuning.infer_boosted: If exactly one face reads 1.0 and the overall level is 1.0, its share = 4.0 - sum(other faces). With two or more faces at 1.0 the shares are ambiguous.
tuning.caveat: A boosted face reads 1.0 until its charge drops below the baseline (100%) capacity, so damage to a boosted face is hidden at first. Charge and tuning are mixed in one value; tuning is only readable at full overall charge.
